scope: Three new employers with directly advertised New York roles. Other consulted employers did not meet the local role/fit/logo threshold; no complete labour-market coverage is claimed.

screening.Bloomberg: Three broad software/platform openings retained. Specialist Kubernetes production, hardware fleet operations, staff data governance and PowerShell-heavy roles excluded.
screening.Oscar Health: Senior backend, senior fullstack and Operations Engineer I retained. Operations Engineer II requires three Python years not established by dated evidence; specialist SRE and leadership tenure not counted.
screening.The New York Times: Frontend, developer platform and elections data-development openings retained. Games web platform excluded as stretch because five years of high-traffic operations is not established. Interns, specialised people-data, production LLM specialism and staff/management roles excluded. Election data advert accepts Python; future R library work and flexible coverage schedule remain visible.
screening.Other New York prospects: Brex, CLEAR, Databricks, Squarespace, Gusto, Current and Duolingo had fewer than three direct local credible matches after specialist/years requirements. DoorDash had several credible roles but no supported declared brand asset from inspected sources. Block had two strong local matches; six-year role and eight-year analytics role were not counted. Reddit and Coinbase boards were predominantly US remote rather than directly New York placements.
